# PDF regression pages: provenance and licensing

The 322 pages `tests/pdf_regression_pages.rs` reads from `test_documents/pdf/regression_pages/`; their snapshots are in `regression_pages/` beside this file.

Single pages cut from public PDFs whose native-text extraction changed between xberg releases (v1.2.8 through v1.3.10 and main): the pages most likely to regress. `crates/xberg/tests/pdf_regression_pages.rs` in xberg compares each page's Markdown with a committed snapshot.

Each file is one page of the source document, saved with pikepdf (annotations and structure-tree links dropped, unreferenced resources removed); nothing on the page was edited. Every source is US federal public domain, CC0, Project Gutenberg public domain or CC BY 4.0; CC BY sources are credited by title, authors and publisher below. `source sha256` is the first 16 hex digits of the whole source PDF's sha256; the page files' hashes are in `regression_pages.sha256` beside this file.
